claim_boundary: This decides only the listed valuation-ranked selector in one four-agent nine-good fixed graph cell at the stated integer cap. It does not decide the full 515-partition chain candidate, row-merge continuation, or complete additive EFX.
domain: positive integer wall values at most 20
interpretation: The exact cap-bounded profile blocks every base pivot and every Hamiltonian path selected by the listed source-wise minimum rules.
policy_meaning: For each source bundle s, policy[s] names the agent whose minimum-valued good in s is moved. All 24 oriented Hamiltonian bundle paths and all tied minima are included.
